UserPrompt: 请把当前工作表 A 列中的'姓名-部门'文本按短横线'-'拆分，姓名保留在 A 列，部门拆分填写到 B 列。不要覆盖其他列已有的数据。
RawModelResponse:
Option Explicit

Sub Main(targetWb As Workbook)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim s As String
    Dim p As Long
    Dim nm As String
    Dim dep As String
    Dim oldScreen As Boolean
    Dim oldEvents As Boolean
    Dim oldCalc As XlCalculation

    If targetWb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    oldScreen = Application.ScreenUpdating
    oldEvents = Application.EnableEvents
    oldCalc = Application.Calculation

    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Set ws = Nothing
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = targetWb.Worksheets("Sheet1")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then Set ws = targetWb.ActiveSheet
    If ws Is Nothing Then GoTo Cleanup

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 1 Then GoTo Cleanup

    For i = 1 To lastRow
        s = CStr(ws.Cells(i, "A").Value2)
        If Len(s) > 0 Then
            p = InStr(1, s, "-", vbBinaryCompare)
            If p > 0 Then
                nm = Trim$(Left$(s, p - 1))
                dep = Trim$(Mid$(s, p + 1))
                ws.Cells(i, "A").Value2 = nm
                ws.Cells(i, "B").Value2 = dep
            End If
        End If
    Next i

Cleanup:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = oldScreen
    Application.EnableEvents = oldEvents
    Application.Calculation = oldCalc
End Sub

CaseTitle: 辅助 Sub/Function 兼容执行
UserPrompt: 请编写一个带辅助 Function 计算阶乘的宏，在当前工作表的 C1:C5 分别计算并写入数字 1 到 5 的阶乘结果。主过程必须调用该辅助 Function。
RawModelResponse:
Sub Main(Optional targetWb As Workbook = Nothing)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim i As Long

    If targetWb Is Nothing Then
        Set wb = ActiveWorkbook
    Else
        Set wb = targetWb
    End If

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets("Sheet1")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        If wb.Worksheets.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    End If

    For i = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(i, 3).Value = Factorial(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Function Factorial(ByVal n As Long) As Double
    Dim result As Double
    Dim k As Long

    If n < 0 Then
        Factorial = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    result = 1
    For k = 2 To n
        result = result * k
    Next k

    Factorial = result
End Function
